note: E1; E3-E4: FY2025 total water consumption fell from 281 ML to 250 ML (about 11%), attributed to monitoring and leak repair; the promised improvement in FY2025 is shown by the figure.
E6; E8-E9: the FY2024 report restates the 15-event target and reports over 80 corporate and social responsibility activities in FY2024, described as surpassing the target.

E5-E7: the 2025 report says installation of the biocarbon plant at United Winery Distillery has started in 2025 and gives its fuel savings in the future tense; no completion or start of operation is reported and there is no later-year evidence.

E5; E8: the 2024 report says the full Scope 3 inventory was completed this year with seven material categories, 'fully deriving all material categories'; E1 records 7 categories disclosed in FY2024 against a target of 4 more.

E2-E3; E9-E10; E12: the 2024 report moves the all-KUD ISPO deadline to 2026; in 2025 only four KUD are certified with one in audit and the rest still being helped toward compliance, and the aim is re-pegged to the national mandatory timeline.

E3; E7; E4-E5; E12: a qualitative scenario analysis was conducted (2024) and is reported in 2025, but the quantitative scenario analysis the company scheduled for 2025 (E4) is deferred to 'coming years' (E5, E12) and E11 still calls scenario analysis a commitment; the promise does not say which kind, so it cannot be told whether the completed analysis is this deliverable.

E7; E10: the 2023 report says even the scaled-back aim of substitution testing for three of the eight industrial products by end 2023 was delayed; the 2024 report is still trialling formulations toward full substitution.

E4; E8; E10-E11: the evidence attaches a 2020 baseline and (E4) 'intensity' that the extraction omits; E4 says 'the target was not achieved on time' after listing both the 5.2% emission and 10% energy targets without saying which; E10 reports a 32% absolute Scope 1+2 reduction from 2020, which would meet an absolute 5.2% target but not necessarily the intensity one. Same ambiguity the group settled as unclear for P00529.

E8-E9: the 2025 report states the five-year 50% waste reduction target was not met and was delayed; the target is waste intensity (sludge and rubber lump per 1000 pieces) from 2020, qualifiers omitted in the extraction, but it is the company's only waste target so the verdict is this commitment's.
E5; E7; E9: FY2022 average training hours of 13.0 per employee against the 10-hour target, reported as surpassed; E6 sets a new 15-hour target for FY2023 but the 2022 result is explicit.
